Physical main/linked relocation keeps UUID/canonical Native key; linked move refuses unrepaired backlinks.
Independent same-name projects, stale CAS, existing-target diff/no-clobber and retained originals.

Unsafe junction/hardlink/Unicode aliases and byte/file/depth/directory caps refuse before success.

limitations: No distributed cross-machine lock or filesystem transaction: partial owned copies are retained; the active registry metadata update is transactional.
Exports/old raw roots are inactive backups, not a second app-owned knowledge authority. Import into another machine/registry needs explicit owner confirmation.
Native Core Read/model/actual Desktop composition remains NOT_RUN here and belongs to U09/U10.
Windows symbolic directory creation is unavailable on this host; real junction/hardlink negatives executed.
rollback: Revert isolated code commit. No production data moved. A failed metadata transaction retains the prior pointer and owned partial target; do not blindly delete/overwrite/retry it.
